result.topic_en: Brief formula-only jottings at the top of an otherwise nearly blank page: lists of reciprocal factors of the form 1/(1-x) for three variables and their primed counterparts, together with associated symmetric-looking expressions; faint bleed-through from the reverse side covers the rest of the page.

methods.what: Factors 1/(1-x) for pairwise products of three variables and their primed counterparts
Expressions of the form -x-y+xy, one for each pair of the variables a, b, c
Expressions of the form x+yz and their reciprocals for the variables a, b, c and their primed counterparts
